    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    ActionPhase
    Handles the Action Phase of a game round, coordinating turn execution for each player according to their position on the offer track.
    ArtistBonusForCavePaintings
    Represents an event-driven building effect that hooks into the global Cave Paintings event phase.
    ArtistCard
    Represents a concrete Character card of type Artist within the tribe deck configuration.
    Board
    Represents the game board managing both the offer track and turn order tile.
    BoardFactory
    Factory class responsible for parsing the game board configuration from a JSON resource file and instantiating the corresponding domain model components based on the player count.
    BoardFactory.BoardComponents
    An immutable container holding the isolated components required to initialize a game board.
    BoardFactory.TurnOrderData
    An internal data transfer object to pair instantiated turn order slots with their associated visual asset path.
    BoardGameAreaController
    Sub-controller for the board's central play area: opponents bar, card rows, offer track, turn order, and decks.
    BoardRenderer
    Concrete CLI renderer.
    BoardSelfPanelController
    Sub-controller for the self-player bar at the bottom of the board: totem marker, tribe columns, building fan, and colour picker.
    BoardViewController
    Main in-game scene controller.
    BonusForCompletedSet
    Implements a reactive building effect that awards a resource payload whenever the player completes a new full set of unique character cards within their tribe.
    BuilderCard
    Represents a concrete Character card of type Builder within the tribe deck configuration.
    BuildingCard
    Represents a specific type of card that allows players to construct buildings.
    BuildingCardFactory
    Factory class responsible for parsing the building cards configuration from a JSON resource file and instantiating BuildingCard objects.
    BuildingDeck
    Manages a building card deck for a specific era.
    BuildingEffect
    Defines the contract for the functional effects associated with building cards.
    Card
    Abstract base class representing a generic game card.
    CardDrawer
    Executes the acquisition of a card from the board, managing the transfer of the card to the player's tribe and the application of associated costs and effects.
    CardDto
    Serializable view of a single card — a character/event/building card or a tribe card.
    CardFormatter
    Pure-static formatting helpers for card type labels and metadata strings.
    CardPrinter
    Prints cards as ASCII boxes ("GUI-like" style) on the console.
    CardView
    Renders a single card (face up or face down) at a chosen size, keeping the standard portrait aspect ratio of the source PNGs.
    CardVisitor
    Visitor interface for processing different types of cards polymorphically.
    CardZoomOverlay
    Translucent overlay that shows a single card at large size on top of the current scene.
    CavePaintingsEventCard
    Represents the global concrete event execution card for the Cave Paintings phase.
    CharacterCard
    Abstract base class for all character-type tribe cards within the game engine.
    ChooseColorCommand
    Game command: the player chooses their colour during setup.
    ClientCallbackImpl
    RMI implementation of ClientCallbackRemote: the client-side receiver of server callbacks in the RMI transport.
    ClientCallbackRemote
    RMI callback exported by the client and invoked by the server to push messages to it (the RMI counterpart of the socket ServerMessage stream).
    ClientCommand
    Root of the client→server command hierarchy.
    ClientCommandVisitor
    Top-level visitor over ClientCommand: dispatches the three families (GameCommand, LobbyCommand, HeartbeatCommand) without knowing the concrete implementations.
    ClientMain
    Entry point for the Mesos GUI client.
    ClientMainCli
    Entry point and interactive driver for the text (CLI) client.
    ClientMainCli.ConnectionConfig
    Holds the transport-level connection configuration entered by the user.
    ClientMainLauncher
    Plain (non-Application) launcher for the GUI client.
    ClientSession
    Immutable snapshot of the local player's session.
    ClientStateListener
    Callback interface implemented by the View (or a presenter) to react to messages coming from the server.
    ClientStateListenerCli
    CLI implementation of ClientStateListener.
    ClientStateListenerGui
    Bridges ClientStateListener callbacks (network thread) to the JavaFX UI by way of a SceneRouter.
    ColorChoosingPhase
    Handles the preliminary phase of the game where players select their representative totem colors before the match officially begins.
    ConnectionHandshaker
    Performs the handshake for a single socket connection, on the per-connection thread spawned by the ServerMain acceptor (never on the acceptor thread, so a slow or hostile client only stalls itself).
    ConnectionProtocol
    Selects the network transport protocol for the client connection.
    ConnectMessage
    Handshake message sent by the socket client right after the connection is established, before entering the command flow: it communicates the name the player wants to register with.
    CreateLobbyCommand
    Lobby command: request to create a new lobby.
    CreateLobbyDialog
    Popup view that shows after the user clicks the button 'create new lobby'.
    DatabaseConfig
    Configuration record for database connection parameters.
    DatabaseManager
    Utility class that manages database connections and initialization.
    DeckView
    A "real" looking deck: several card-back images stacked with a small xy offset, so it reads as a pile of cards on the table.
    DrawCardCommand
    Game command: the player draws/selects a card from the offer.
    DrawCardsAction
    Corresponds to the "Draw Cards" action on offer tiles.
    EndGameBuildingEffect
    Implements a deferred end-game scoring strategy for building cards.
    EndGameScoringDto
    End-of-game scoring snapshot.
    EndOfGamePhase
    Represents the final phase of the game, executing the teardown sequence and finalizing the match statistics.
    EndOfRoundPhase
    Represents the transitional phase executed at the end of each game round, responsible for standard event resolution and phase branching.
    EndTurnCommand
    Game command: the player declares their turn over.
    Era
     
    ErrorMessage
    Server→client message notifying an application error (e.g.
    ErrorToast
    Top-right transient notification.
    EventCard
    Abstract base class for all global event cards within the game lifecycle.
    EventResolutionDto
    Snapshot of one event card resolution.
    EventResolutionOverlay
    Themed modal overlay that presents event-resolution results one at a time.
    EventResolutionOverlay.PendingEvent
    Immutable container pairing an event card's root StackPane with the data needed to render it.
    EventResolvedMessage
    Server → client notification emitted once per resolved event card during EndOfRoundPhase (and EndOfGamePhase for residual events).
    EventResolver
    A specialized stateful visitor responsible for sequencing and resolving event cards from a heterogeneous collection of tribe cards.
    EventType
     
    FoodWidget
    Food icon + amount label.
    GameCommand
    Family of commands that mutate the state of an ongoing game (choose colour, place totem, draw card, end turn).
    GameCommandVisitor
    Visitor over the subtypes of GameCommand.
    GameController
    Engine for a game session.
    GameModel
    Authoritative game state.
    GameModel.LeaderboardData
    Immutable snapshot of the DB leaderboard, atomically publishable.
    GameOverMessage
    Game-over notification carrying the winners and (optionally) the end-game scoring breakdown.
    GamePhase
     
    GamePhaseHandler
    Defines the behavior of a game phase handler.
    GameServerRemote
    Remote interface exported by the server to RMI clients.
    GameServerRemoteImpl
    RMI server endpoint (GameServerRemote implementation).
    GameStartingMessage
    Server→client message signalling the game start: the lobby is full and the client must switch from the lobby screen to the game screen.
    GameStateDto
    Serializable snapshot of the whole game state, sent to clients inside a StateMessage.
    GameStateDtoBuilder
    Builder class for constructing GameStateDto objects from the game model.
    GameStateDtoBuilder.ActionDetailsExtractor
    OfferTileActionVisitor implementation to extract details from an offer tile's action for DTO construction.
    GameStateDtoBuilder.CardToDtoVisitor
    Builds a CardDto from a card by visiting it.
    GameStateRenderer
    Renders the game state to the console.
    GathererCard
    Represents a concrete Character card of type Gatherer within the tribe deck configuration.
    HeartbeatCommand
    Application-level heartbeat sent periodically by the client to the server to signal that the connection is still alive.
    HeartbeatMessage
    Heartbeat message sent periodically by the server to the client to signal that the connection is still alive.
    HunterBonusForHuntEvent
    Represents a specific event-driven building effect that hooks into the global Hunt event phase.
    HunterCard
    Represents a concrete Character card of type Hunter within the tribe deck configuration.
    HuntEventCard
    Represents the global concrete event execution card for the Hunt phase.
    ImageCache
    Application-wide cache for JavaFX Image objects.
    InventionIcon
     
    InventorCard
    Represents a concrete Character card of type Inventor within the tribe deck configuration.
    InventorsPairBonus
    Implements a reactive building effect that awards a resource bonus whenever a new pair of matching invention icons is formed within the player's tribe.
    JoinLobbyCommand
    Lobby command: request to join an existing lobby.
    LeaderboardMessage
    Server→client message with the persisted leaderboard and the player's placement at the end of the game.
    LeaderboardOverlay
    Full-screen overlay showing the global DB leaderboard.
    LeaveCommand
    Command to leave a lobby or an ongoing game.
    ListLobbiesCommand
    Lobby command: request for the list of available lobbies.
    LivenessSentinel
    Bidirectional liveness abstraction encapsulating a periodic heartbeat sender and a watchdog.
    Lobby
    A pre-game gathering of PlayerEntrys waiting for the lobby to fill up.
    LobbyCommand
    Family of commands concerning the lifecycle of lobbies and sessions (create/join/list/leave, player registration, disconnections and reconnections).
    LobbyCommandVisitor
    Visitor over LobbyCommand.
    LobbyDisconnectCommand
    Server-internal disconnection command.
    LobbyDto
    Serializable view of a lobby shown in the menu (lobby list / lobby state).
    LobbyListMessage
    Server→client message with the list of available lobbies, in response to ListLobbiesCommand.
    LobbyManager
    Central registry and manager for every client session on the server.
    LobbyStateMessage
    Server→client message with the updated state of the lobby the player belongs to (e.g.
    LobbyViewController
    Lobby browser: refresh, create, join.
    LobbyViewController.LobbyCell
    Custom ListCell implementation to restyle the display of each lobby in the ListView.
    LocalGameState
    Client-side view of the game state.
    MatchDAO
    Data Access Object (DAO) responsible for executing CRUD operations related to match histories.
    MoveChecker
    Evaluates the legality of potential card draws for a specific player, determining if any valid or forced moves remain available on the board.
    MusicManager
    Singleton responsible for background music playback.
    MusicPlayerWidget
    Compact music-control widget displayed in the application top bar.
    NetworkSetupViewController
    First connection screen.
    NetworkUtil
    Network helpers shared between server and client mains.
    NickViewController
    Second connection screen.
    OfferTile
    Represents a single offer tile on the board where a player's totem can be placed.
    OfferTileAction
    Defines the contract for an action that can be performed on an offer tile.
    OfferTileActionVisitor
    Visitor for OfferTileAction subtypes.
    OfferTileDto
    Serializable view of an offer (action) tile: its letter, action type, the occupant (if any) and, for draw tiles, the per-row draw limits and how many draws have already been used this turn.
    OfferTileView
    One offer-track tile with the (optional) occupant's totem overlaid.
    OfferTrack
    Manages the offer track component of the board.
    OnAcquireBuildingEffect
    Abstract base class for building effects that trigger dynamically upon character card acquisition.
    OnEventBuildingEffect
    Base class and default no-op implementation for building effects triggered by global game events.
    OnPickingEffects
    Implements an immediate execution strategy for building effects activated upon card acquisition.
    PlacementPhase
    Orchestrates the sequential totem placement phase, where players select their desired offer tiles for the upcoming round based on the established turn order.
    PlaceTotemCommand
    Game command: the player places their totem on an offer tile.
    Player
    Represents a player participating in the game, encapsulating their persistent identity, resources, and state.
    PlayerDisconnectedCommand
    Server-internal lifecycle command.
    PlayerDto
    Serializable view of a player: resources (food, prestige points), totem colour and location, and the acquired TribeDto.
    PlayerEntry
    Server-side representation of a connected player, transport-agnostic.
    PlayerEventDeltaDto
    Per-player delta produced by a single event resolution.
    PlayerReconnectedCommand
    Server-internal lifecycle command.
    PlayerScoringDeltaDto
    Breakdown of the five end-game scoring sources for a single player.
    PlayerViewController
    Small marker around the table for each player.
    PpWidget
    Prestige-points crown with the amount overlaid at centre.
    PreEndOfRoundPhase
    Represents a specialized transitional phase preceding the end of a round, dedicated exclusively to resolving the "extra draw" bonus mechanic.
    RegisterRmiPlayerCommand
    Server-internal registration command for an RMI player.
    RegisterSocketPlayerCommand
    Server-internal registration command for a socket player.
    RmiPlayerEntry
    RMI implementation of PlayerEntry.
    RmiVirtualServer
    RMI implementation of the client-side VirtualServer proxy.
    RmiVirtualView
    Server-side view of an RMI client.
    RowsManager
    Manages the four card rows that form the central board offer, together with the underlying decks and event resolution logic.
    RulesOverlay
    Full-screen in-game overlay that renders the rules PDF page by page using Apache PDFBox and displays them in a scrollable panel.
    SceneController
    Contract for screen-level controllers managed by SceneRouter.
    SceneRouter
    Single navigation hub for the whole GUI.
    ScoreRecord
    Represents an immutable data transfer object (DTO) containing a player's match result.
    ServerMain
    Entry point of the Mesos game server.
    ServerMessage
    Root of the server→client message hierarchy.
    ServerMessageVisitor
    Visitor over ServerMessage, implemented by the client side to react to each kind of server message (state update, errors, game over, lobby list/state, game start, heartbeat, leaderboard, event outcome) without resorting to instanceof.
    SetupPhase
    Handles the setup phase of the game.
    ShamanCard
    Represents a concrete Character card of type Shaman within the tribe deck configuration.
    ShamanicRitualEventCard
    Represents the global concrete event execution card for the Shamanic Ritual phase.
    SocketClientHandler
    Reader for a single socket client, run on the per-player client-<name> thread.
    SocketClientThread
    Background thread that continuously reads objects from the socket's ObjectInputStream and dispatches them to the SocketVirtualServer.
    SocketPlayerEntry
    Socket implementation of PlayerEntry.
    SocketVirtualServer
    Socket implementation of VirtualServer proxy.
    SocketVirtualView
    Server-side view of a socket client.
    SplashViewController
    Static "MESOS" splash.
    StateMessage
    Server→client message carrying the full snapshot of the game state; it is the main message the client uses to update its view.
    SummaryCardOverlay
    Full-screen in-game overlay that shows one or more SummaryCard images.
    SuspensionTimeoutCommand
    Server-internal lifecycle command.
    SustenanceDiscountEffect
    Implements an event-driven building effect that provides an economic resource mitigation (food discount) during the global Sustenance event resolution phase.
    SustenanceEventCard
    Represents the global concrete event execution card for the Sustenance phase.
    TakeFoodAction
    Implements the "Take Food" strategy for offer tile actions.

    TotemLocation
     
    TotemPickViewController
    Shown after the lobby fills and before the board appears.
    TotemView
    Visual marker for a player's totem.
    Tribe
    Represents a player's tribe, acting as the in-game inventory of every CharacterCard and BuildingCard acquired during the match.
    TribeCard
    Abstract base class representing a card belonging to the main Tribe deck.
    TribeCardFactory
    Factory class responsible for parsing the tribe cards configuration from a JSON resource file and instantiating polymorphic concrete implementations of TribeCard.
    TribeCardFactory.TribeCardCollection
    An immutable container holding the complete collection of instantiated tribe cards, segregated into regular game cards and final event cards.

    TribeDto
    DTO snapshot of a player's tribe (acquired cards).
    TribePopupController
    Popup that shows another player's full tribe.
    TurnOrderSlot
    Represents a slot in the turn order tile where a player's totem can be placed.
    TurnOrderSlotDto
    Serializable view of a single slot in the turn-order track: its 0-based position and the occupant, or null when the slot is free.
    TurnOrderTile
    Manages the turn order tile component of the board.
    TurnOrderTileView
    The TurnOrderTile of the board, showing the n-player tile background and any totems currently sitting on its slots.
    ViewController
    Interface for all view controllers.
    VirtualServer
    Client-side, transport-agnostic proxy of the server: the facade the UI uses to talk to the server.
    VirtualServerFactory
    Opens the transport layer for the chosen ConnectionProtocol and returns an un-named VirtualServer.
    VirtualView
    Server-side, transport-agnostic outbound channel to a single client.
    WaitingViewController
    Shown after the player joined a lobby that is not yet full.
    WinnerViewController
    Last screen of the GUI.
